user_question: Calculate mean elevation for the State College census tracts using elevation data at 30-meter resolution or finer.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Calculate mean elevation for the State College census tracts using elevation data at 30-meter resolution or finer.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve State College census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain a GeoPackage polygon layer representing the State College census tracts required for zonal statistics.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve the highest-ranked available census-tract polygon dataset covering the State College boundary represented by input_3. Treat the result as a candidate until runtime QC verifies its spatial coverage, polygon geometry, CRS, and tract identifier fields.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate mean elevation by census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Compute the mean elevation within each State College census tract using the supplied 30-meter elevation raster.
workflow_steps.instructions: Run zonal statistics using input_2 as the elevation raster and census_tracts as the polygon zones. Compute mean elevation for every tract and preserve a grounded tract identifier in the CSV output. Use input_2, not the optional 90-meter input_1, as the analytical elevation source.

requirements.scope: The retrieved census_tracts candidate must cover the State College census tracts represented by input_3.
The analytical elevation raster must have pixel resolution no coarser than 30 meters.
The zonal statistics inputs must be in formats supported by the raster analysis worker.
The census_tracts zone layer must have a known CRS before zonal statistics.
The elevation raster and census_tracts zones must use compatible CRSs.
All census_tracts polygon geometries used as zones must be valid and non-empty.
The census_tracts layer must contain a field that uniquely identifies each census tract, with the actual field name grounded from runtime schema evidence.

agent_profile_snapshot.name: Raster Analysis Agent
agent_profile_snapshot.description: Performs deterministic raster reprojection, resampling, clipping, raster calculation, and zonal statistics. Consumes GeoTIFF rasters and GeoPackage polygon zones.

skills.name: Raster Geoprocessing
skills.description: Executes raster calculations, reprojections, grid resampling, spatial masking, and zonal aggregations.

constraints.spatial: Raster calculation requires compatible grid definitions and CRS. Zonal statistics require matching CRS between raster and GeoPackage zones.
other: Accepts GeoTIFF (.tif) rasters and GeoPackage (.gpkg) polygon zones.
Does not accept GeoJSON zones for zonal statistics.
